newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens takes stake in internet specialist.
newsitem.headline: Siemens takes stake in internet specialist.

text.p: Siemens AG said on Tuesday it had established a U.S. unit which has taken a 20 percent stake in U.S. internet specialist Persimmon IT Inc.

The new business unit will provide internet telecommunications solutions. It is part of the Siemens public communications networks division and is integrated into Siemens Stromberg-Carlson of Boca Raton, Florida.
It aims for cumulated sales of $1.2 billion by the year 2000, mainly from network operators, service providers and cable TV companies.
"In future even more telephone, fax and video communication will take place via the internet," Siemens said in a statement.

Persimmon, based in Durham, North Carolina, is active in the design and development of sites for the World Wide Web. It has 50 employees and aims to double its sales -- now equivalent to 100 million marks -- this year.
The price of the stake was not disclosed.
